annotation.title_clean: Malta: The Ultimate AI Launchpad – A Strategy and Vision for Artificial Intelligence in Malta 2030
annotation.title_en: Malta: The Ultimate AI Launchpad – A Strategy and Vision for Artificial Intelligence in Malta 2030
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Parliamentary Secretariat for Financial Services, Digital Economy and Innovation (Malta); Malta.AI Taskforce
annotation.summary_en: Malta's 2019 national AI strategy sets a vision to become the 'Ultimate AI Launchpad' by 2030. It covers investment, public and private sector adoption, education, legal and ethical measures (voluntary AI certification, regulatory and data sandboxes), and ecosystem infrastructure. Physical AI is mentioned only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Launch world's first voluntary national AI certification programme based on the Ethical AI Framework 'Towards Trustworthy AI', audited by MDIA-authorised experts
Establish a Technology Regulation Advisory Committee, a Regulatory Sandbox for AI and a Data Sandbox for AI
MDIA to oversee and govern strategy implementation
Six public sector AI pilot projects (traffic, education, health, customer service, tourism, utilities) by 2022
Investment incentives, R&D support, talent visas, and AI skills and workforce programmes
